customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as ARGs, resolved via the '# renovate:' comment above each

packageRules.description: Docker CLI and Compose are apt pins, so the apt index is the source of truth - moby/moby releases are only a proxy and provably miss shipped versions (28.4.0, 28.5.0-28.5.2 have no moby tag at all) while adding RCs. NOTE: suite=trixie must be bumped in step with the FROM line in the Dockerfile. extractVersion strips the epoch and Debian revision (5:29.8.0-1~debian.13~trixie -> 29.8.0); the epoch group is optional because docker-ce-cli has one and docker-compose-plugin does not.
Renovate itself needs Node >= 24, so keep the runner's Node on a current LTS line

Major bumps of the toolchain change build behaviour - always review by hand. Scoped to the managers that actually change the image: the commitBody is load-bearing, because the release workflow's tag action substring-matches the commit log for MAJOR_STRING_TOKEN='BREAKING CHANGE:'. Left unscoped it would also catch github-actions majors, cutting a major IMAGE release for a CI-only change.
packageRules.commitBody: BREAKING CHANGE: major toolchain version bump - review upstream upgrade notes before rolling this image out.

packageRules.description: Workflow action pins. 'ci:' matches none of the tag action's bump tokens, so these never influence the image version.
Base image majors (debian) are a deliberate decision, not a routine bump
